function_definitions.m2_is_valid_iana_timezone:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.m2_is_valid_iana_timezone(tz text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT tz IS NOT NULL
     AND btrim(tz) <> ''
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names z
       WHERE z.name = tz
     );
$function$
